name: Things in Motion
thesis: Raygen’s portfolio becomes a widescreen opening sequence, with his actual builds cast as the protagonists.
interaction: A three-scene filmstrip and previous/next controls cut between SERV0, DAVID, and Stardance with a brief aperture wipe; scene notes change with the selection, and reduced motion uses instant cuts.
why: Centered printer portraits, warm cinematic credits, and a visitor-controlled sequence give the engineering work a personal atmosphere without inventing footage or turning Raygen into a service offering.
